title: Hanasato Minori — Falling With Honor〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you seem pretty happy today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Check out this picture...!
Especially you, Haruka!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What picture?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait... Th-That's...!
PenPyon?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We got it from a claw machine at SpoJoy Park!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: SpoJoy Park...? The sports facility by the station? Hang on. Did you go there just to get this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Remember how I went out to exercise with Kanade? The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? So, you went to SpoJoy Park with Hoshino and a couple others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We went to the arcade and got in some exercise by rollerblading, playing bubble sumo and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, I'm surprised.
I didn't think Ena would be interested in exercising since she prefers to stay at home most of the time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. Wait, didn't she mention something about swelling in her feet or ankles when we messaged her the other day?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, she did say that!
That might be why she thought that she needed to exercise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kanade also said that she wanted to increase her stamina so that she can keep composing music...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Increase her stamina to compose music?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we can do something less strenuous and more fun this time! Maybe something simple, like the trampoline!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Fun...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, but I'd like to do something a bit more challenging...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I appreciate the concern you're showing for me, but since I'm here, I want to increase my stamina as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because if I don't, I would've skipped working on music for nothing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Kanade had such a serious look on her face that time.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I guess it's a testament to just how much composing music means to her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But it was nice to see her having so much fun when we played strike zone together.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! I'm sorry...!
What you said reminded me of something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, Haruka, I'd like you to have this PenPyon!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? I'm speechless... But you worked really hard to get it, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, very!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We thought we could get it initially by rolling it to the chute, but that didn't go so well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, Ena asked her brother's friend who's good at winning stuff from claw machines for some advice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We took their advice and I had Kanade help me with the timing and stuff... And voila! We got it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, we worked really hard to get it, but it's also why I want it to go to someone who'll take good care of it. So, what do you say?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After working so hard to get it, I couldn't be happier to hear that you believe I'll take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But... I can't accept your PenPyon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
Wh-Why not?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You just said so yourself just now, right? How winning it was a collective effort.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you all worked together to get that PenPyon, I think it should stay with you as a reminder of how much fun you all had at SpoJoy Park.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also have to think that PenPyon would like the same since you worked so hard to get it, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if it's alright with you, Minori, I'd like to see it the next time I visit your house.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so nice of you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only did you think about how Minori would feel, you also took PenPyon's feelings into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.
